title: Mobile App Developer
tagline: Ship iOS and Android apps from one JavaScript codebase
description: Use the web skills you already have to build native mobile apps. After JavaScript and TypeScript you learn React, then React Native with Expo, connect your app to REST APIs and manage the code with Git. Flutter and Ionic are offered as alternatives.
audience: Web developers who want to build mobile apps without learning two native toolchains

stages.title: JavaScript
stages.description: Language fundamentals, asynchronous code and modules.

stages.title: TypeScript
stages.description: Static types, interfaces and generics for safer, larger application codebases.

stages.title: React
stages.description: Components, hooks, state and data fetching.

stages.title: React Native
stages.description: Native components, navigation, styling, device APIs and Expo. Flutter (Dart) and Ionic are alternatives.

stages.title: Working with APIs
stages.description: Consume REST APIs, handle auth tokens and cache data offline.

stages.title: Git and app publishing
stages.description: Version your app and prepare store releases.

seo.title: Mobile App Developer Learning Path
seo.description: Roadmap from JavaScript and TypeScript through React to React Native with Expo, REST APIs and publishing mobile apps.
